body: This is looking a lot better now! I'm lifting my NAK since the regression was fixed. I still have some style comments though.

Actually, I've come around. I think the behavior change for reserving in the above conversation makes sense (and it's precedented; `reserve` does the same in Rust).

I also want to note that 1.5x seems to be a common modern growth factor. It's often been told why, but I found [folly's](https://github.com/facebook/folly/blob/main/folly/docs/FBVector.md#memory-handling) explanations to be pretty detailed. We'll probably want to adopt a more sophisticated allocation algorithm too, but I think it's fine to move forward with this PR even without it.
